title: The quiet hunter
text:
Orion rested his bow beside a stone. For once, there was nothing to chase.

Above him, the stars waited in their patient places. He wondered whether a story could travel farther than a hunter’s feet.
marginNotes: This is an imagined scene, offered as a sample of the tone.

title: A warm light
text:
In the sky’s picture of Orion, a reddish light rests on his shoulder: **Betelgeuse**.

Glaux might say, *a name is one way to begin looking*. The tale gives us a figure to remember; astronomy gives us a star to wonder about.
marginNotes: Betelgeuse is a red supergiant. A constellation is a pattern as seen from Earth.
